A video of Anwar singing, from memory, Kishore Kumar’s 1965 hit ballad “Khwab Ho Tum Ya Koi Haqeeqat” (“Are you a dream or are you reality?”) was first posted to his social media accounts last Sunday before quickly being picked up by Indian news outlets. watch.titleZh: 安瓦尔在印度一展歌喉，马来西亚能否从中获益？
watch.summaryZh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔在访问印度期间演唱了一首宝莱坞经典歌曲，这一轻松时刻反映了他加强与印度双边关系的意图。该视频在社交媒体上迅速传播，并引起了印度媒体的广泛关注。
watch.whyImportant: 通过文化外交手段，安瓦尔旨在深化马来西亚与印度之间的战略与经济联系。

watch.title: Michelle Bachelet exits UN chief race after low poll support
watch.summary: Former Chilean President Michelle Bachelet ends her bid to be the first woman to lead the United Nations.
watch.titleZh: 因民调支持率低，米歇尔·巴切莱特退出联合国秘书长竞选
watch.summaryZh: 智利前总统米歇尔·巴切莱特宣布结束其竞选活动，放弃成为联合国首位女性领导人的机会。
watch.whyImportant: 此次退出标志着联合国秘书长竞选格局的变动，减少了该职位出现首位女性候选人的可能性。

watch.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
watch.summary: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.
watch.titleZh: 胡塞武装称其用弹道导弹袭击了沙特首都
watch.summaryZh: 沙特阿拉伯表示拦截了一枚瞄准首都利雅得的弹道导弹。据报道，利雅得机场的一处燃料库遭到袭击，导致周六航班延误。
watch.whyImportant: 此次袭击事件加剧了地区安全局势的紧张，并对沙特境内的基础设施安全构成威胁。

more.summary: Premier Ben Carroll says a re-elected Labor government will legislate a new form of manslaughter and increase maximum penalty for rape to life imprisonment Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast A re-elected Victorian Labor government will create two new Australian-first offences aimed at closing “loopholes” it says have allowed perpetrators of family violence to escape punishment. more.titleZh: 维多利亚州工党承诺堵住漏洞，防止家暴施暴者逃脱法律制裁
more.summaryZh: 维多利亚州州长本·卡罗尔承诺，若工党连任，将立法设立新的过失杀人罪，并提高强奸罪的最高刑罚至终身监禁。新法案旨在填补法律漏洞，针对因家暴导致受害者自杀或遗弃受害者的行为进行严惩。
more.whyImportant: 该政策旨在强化对家庭暴力受害者的保护，并填补现有法律在处理极端家暴案件时的空白。

items.title: Australia news live: Plibersek says ‘we owe these women more than our sorrow’ after NSW deaths; Chalmers flags ‘confronting’ 40-year outlook
items.summary: Follow live updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast The prime minister has been asked if Australia has any plans to join the EU, after the Canadian prime minister, Mark Carney, welcomed the offer of Canada becoming the EU’s first associate member. Anthony Albanese says “we’re a long way from Europe, of course”, but after it is pointed out that Canada is too, he says: Our relations, of course, are also in areas that Canada doesn’t have. So Asean, for example, and the centrality of Asean in our region is important. The Pacific Island Forum, where I was just a couple of weeks ago, is very important as well. Our priority when it comes to Europe and our engagement with the EU is, of course, Australia-EU free trade agreement. It was never going to be perfect, but in the legislation that we passed just in the last sitting fortnight, I can tell you … that already the eSafety Commissioner has used that strengthening of the laws to require some of the social media organisations to provide information to it, so they’ve already been compelled. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚新闻直播：普利贝尔塞克称新南威尔士州死亡事件后“我们欠这些女性的不仅是哀悼”；查尔默斯预警40年经济前景“令人不安”
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯回应了关于澳大利亚是否会加入欧盟的询问，强调澳大利亚目前优先考虑与欧盟的自由贸易协定。同时，政府正利用新立法加强对社交媒体平台的监管，以强制其提供相关信息。
items.whyImportant: 此消息反映了澳大利亚在处理国内社会安全问题及平衡国际贸易与区域外交关系方面的政策重点。

items.title: Hong Kong’s first leader Tung Chee-hwa receives state funeral – as it happened
items.summary: Hong Kong bid farewell to its first post-colonial chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, on Sunday at a state funeral – only the third time a Hongkonger has received such an honour since the 1997 handover. Tung, who died at the age of 89 on September 8, led Hong Kong through a series of ups and downs, including the 1997 Asian financial crisis, the 2003 Sars outbreak and the V-shaped economic recovery that followed. Sunday’s funeral follows a vigil held the previous day at the Hong Kong Funeral Home...
items.titleZh: 香港首任特首董建华举行国葬——事件回顾
items.summaryZh: 香港为首任行政长官董建华举行了国葬，这是1997年回归以来第三位获此殊荣的香港人。董建华于9月8日去世，享年89岁，他曾带领香港度过亚洲金融危机及非典疫情等重大挑战。
items.whyImportant: 作为香港回归后的首位领导人，董建华的离世标志着香港一个重要历史时期的终结。

items.title: How did the US recall a billion products in six months?
items.summary: The US recalled to a billion products off the market in just six months.
items.titleZh: 美国如何在六个月内召回了十亿件产品？
items.summaryZh: 在短短六个月内，美国市场经历了高达十亿件产品的召回事件。这一大规模召回行动引发了对产品安全监管体系的关注。
items.whyImportant: 如此大规模的产品召回反映了美国消费品市场在质量控制与安全合规方面存在的严峻挑战。

items.title: Top Hong Kong officials, business leaders mourn Tung Chee-hwa – as it happened
items.summary: Hong Kong mourned the loss of its first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, in a vigil on Saturday, with tributes pouring in from political and business heavyweights as well as members of the public. Saturday’s rituals, held at Hong Kong Funeral Home in North Point, will be followed by a state...
items.titleZh: 香港高官及商界领袖悼念董建华——事件回顾
items.summaryZh: 香港各界人士在北角香港殡仪馆举行守灵仪式，悼念已故首任行政长官董建华。政商界领袖及公众纷纷表达哀思，回顾其在任期间应对多次经济与公共卫生危机的历程。
items.whyImportant: 此次悼念活动体现了香港社会对首任特首历史贡献的集体记忆与尊重。

items.title: Hong Kong leader says firms must strive to survive despite government support
items.summary: Hong Kong’s leader has defended measures in his policy address to boost the economy and improve livelihoods, stressing that businesses must also do their part to remain competitive and survive, even with government aid. items.titleZh: 香港特首称尽管有政府支持，企业仍需努力求生
items.summaryZh: 香港行政长官李家超在回应民生政策时表示，政府虽提供经济援助，但企业自身仍需提升竞争力以应对市场挑战。他强调发展经济是改善民生的前提。
items.whyImportant: 此表态反映了香港政府在经济下行压力下，对企业自救能力与政府扶持政策边界的考量。

items.title: People in China earn between US$7 and US$15,000 by licensing faces to AI content producers
items.summary: In China, an increasing number of digital face-licensing platforms are connecting ordinary individuals with content creators, enabling them to authorise the use of their likenesses in AI-generated short dramas, advertisements, and games. Since April, private “face-selling” transactions that once circulated within film and television industry chat groups have progressively transitioned to public platforms. One bank employee reportedly earned nearly 2,500 yuan (US$370) after an advertising company...
items.titleZh: 中国民众通过向AI内容制作商授权肖像权赚取7至15000美元
items.summaryZh: 中国出现了一批数字肖像授权平台，连接普通民众与内容创作者，允许后者在AI生成的短剧、广告和游戏中合法使用其肖像。此类交易已从私下渠道转向公开平台，成为部分民众的额外收入来源。
items.whyImportant: 该现象反映了AI产业发展对个人肖像权商业化模式的重塑及相关法律伦理挑战。

items.title: Ed Sheeran calls Gaza situation ‘unjustifiable’ after Palestine controversy
items.summary: Ed Sheeran opened a concert on Saturday with comments about Gaza after controversy swirled around his tour and supporting acts withdrew in solidarity with opener Macklemore, who was dropped after making pro-Palestinian comments onstage. Sheeran began the concert alone on stage with no opener, but was joined by other musicians later in the show. Sheeran said he wanted his music and shows to be about unity and humanity, not politics. But he said the attacks in Israel of October 7, 2023, were...
items.titleZh: 艾德·希兰在巴勒斯坦争议后称加沙局势“不可辩解”
items.summaryZh: 歌手艾德·希兰在演唱会开场时谈及加沙局势，此前因开场嘉宾麦克莫尔发表亲巴勒斯坦言论被撤换而引发争议。希兰表示希望音乐能传递团结与人性，但也对2023年10月7日的袭击事件发表了看法。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了全球艺人在处理地缘政治冲突议题时所面临的舆论压力与立场困境。

items.title: Iran war live: Tehran sets terms for talks; Saudi forces foil Riyadh attack
items.summary: Iran security chief says Tehran's demands include an end to war on all fronts and the lifting of US's naval blockade.
items.titleZh: 伊朗战争直播：德黑兰设定谈判条件；沙特军队挫败利雅得袭击
items.summaryZh: 伊朗安全部门负责人表示，德黑兰提出的谈判条件包括结束各条战线的战争，以及解除美国的全面海上封锁。与此同时，沙特方面成功阻止了针对利雅得的袭击。
items.whyImportant: 中东地区紧张局势的升级与谈判条件的提出，对区域安全稳定具有重大影响。

items.title: More Australians to live into their 90s as life expectancy forecast to rise over coming decades
items.summary: Treasury’s latest intergenerational report projects life expectancy at birth will reach 89 for women and 86 for men by 2066 Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Australian households will shrink but more people can expect to live well into their 90s, according to the latest update to forecasts of the country’s long-term future. Treasury’s latest intergenerational report, to be published in full on Monday, will project the impact of government policies 40 years into the future. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 随着预期寿命延长，未来几十年将有更多澳大利亚人活到90岁以上
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚财政部最新的代际报告预测，到2066年，女性和男性的出生时预期寿命将分别达到89岁和86岁。报告指出，尽管家庭规模将缩小，但长寿人口比例将显著增加。
items.whyImportant: 人口老龄化趋势的加剧将对澳大利亚未来的社会福利、医疗体系及经济政策产生深远影响。

items.title: Not all AI workers think the tech could kill everyone
items.summary: In text exchanges and conversations, multiple people who have worked for leading companies are sceptical of the warnings.
items.titleZh: 并非所有人工智能从业者都认为该技术会毁灭人类
items.summaryZh: 多名曾在领先人工智能公司工作的人员在交流中表示，对有关AI将毁灭人类的警告持怀疑态度。他们认为这些极端预测并不代表行业内部的共识。
items.whyImportant: 这一观点揭示了人工智能领域内部对于技术风险评估存在显著的分歧。

items.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
items.summary: Denmark and the US have reached an agreement after months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory.
items.titleZh: 北约欢迎格陵兰协议，特朗普称其将赋予美国“永久安全控制权”
items.summaryZh: 在唐纳德·特朗普多次威胁要吞并格陵兰岛后，丹麦与美国最终达成了一项协议。特朗普声称该协议将确保美国对该地区拥有永久的安全控制权。
items.whyImportant: 此协议改变了北极地区的地缘政治格局，并引发了关于领土主权与国际安全关系的讨论。

items.title: The cooling trap: how Asia’s air conditioners are making heatwaves worse
items.summary: As heatwaves become more frequent and intense across Asia, the region faces a dangerous power paradox. Soaring demand for air conditioning threatens to push electricity grids closer to failure just as extreme heat puts the infrastructure under greater strain, raising the risk of cooling disappearing when people need it most. That risk has been visible across the region this summer. In South Korea, President Lee Jae Myung called a record heatwave a “national disaster” in August after the death...
items.titleZh: 降温陷阱：亚洲的空调如何加剧了热浪影响
items.summaryZh: 随着亚洲热浪频发，对空调的需求激增，这导致电力负荷过重，增加了电网崩溃的风险。这种恶性循环使得在极端高温下维持电力供应变得愈发困难。
items.whyImportant: 能源需求与气候变化之间的矛盾，正成为亚洲城市基础设施面临的重大安全挑战。

items.title: Is China’s fabled Empress Dowager Huayang buried near an airport? A study says yes
items.summary: An airport is an unlikely place to search for national origins but researchers say they have uncovered the tomb of the woman behind the man who unified China – next to a major city runway. The researchers said the tomb was believed to belong to Empress Dowager Huayang, the adoptive grandmother of Qin Shi Huang, who unified the warring states more than 2,200 years ago. “I believe the most likely identity of the tomb owner is Empress Dowager Huayang,” Zhao Hanqing, from the Shaanxi Provincial...
items.titleZh: 中国传说中的华阳太后葬在机场附近吗？一项研究称是的
items.summaryZh: 研究人员在某大型城市机场跑道旁发现了一座古墓，认为其主人极有可能是秦始皇的祖母华阳太后。该发现为研究这位统一六国君主背后的历史人物提供了新线索。
items.whyImportant: 这一考古发现有助于进一步厘清秦朝历史及相关皇室成员的墓葬分布。

items.title: What China really means when it says it’s being ‘strategic’
items.summary: On September 12, Chinese President Xi Jinping met Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi on the sidelines of the Brics summit in New Delhi. In their talks, Xi said China approached the relationship “from a strategic and long-term perspective”. He called for an objective and rational “strategic” perception. items.titleZh: 中国所说的“战略性”究竟意味着什么
items.summaryZh: 中国国家主席习近平在与印度总理莫迪会晤时提到，应从“战略和长远角度”处理双边关系。在外交语境中，这通常意味着双方应将彼此视为合作伙伴而非竞争对手，强调理性与客观的认知。
items.whyImportant: 理解中国外交术语有助于国际社会更准确地解读其对外政策意图与双边关系走向。

items.title: Peruvian journalist shot dead after threatening to expose police
items.summary: Peruvian journalist ‘China Polo’ has been shot dead a week after receiving death threats over a police investigation.
items.titleZh: 秘鲁记者在威胁曝光警察后遭枪杀
items.summaryZh: 秘鲁记者“China Polo”在收到关于警方调查的死亡威胁一周后被枪杀。目前相关案件引发了对新闻自由与人身安全的关注。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了调查记者在揭露腐败时所面临的极端暴力风险。

items.title: A ‘ban on the free press’: White House bars journalists from three outlets
items.summary: Reporters from CNN, MS NOW, and Politico were denied access to White House on Saturday.
items.titleZh: “禁止自由媒体”：白宫禁止三家媒体机构的记者进入
items.summaryZh: 周六，CNN、MS NOW和Politico的记者被拒绝进入白宫。此举引发了关于媒体准入权与政府透明度的争议。
items.whyImportant: 政府限制特定媒体进入白宫引发了外界对新闻自由和行政透明度的担忧。

items.title: White House bars CNN, MS Now and Politico reporters after Trump ban
items.summary: The White House on Saturday denied access to journalists from CNN, MS Now and Politico, following through with US President Donald Trump’s announcement that he would ban them from the building’s grounds. All three news outlets separately said their teams’ press passes were ‌confiscated on Saturday morning when their journalists went to the White House. They have signalled that they may contest the ban on the grounds that it conflicts with the US Constitution’s First Amendment protections for...
items.titleZh: 白宫在特朗普下达禁令后禁止CNN、MS Now和Politico记者进入
items.summaryZh: 白宫周六拒绝了CNN、MS Now和Politico记者的进入请求，落实了美国总统特朗普此前宣布的禁令。这三家媒体表示其记者的白宫通行证已被没收，并暗示可能以违反美国宪法第一修正案为由提出抗议。
items.whyImportant: 此举引发了关于新闻自由与政府行政权力边界的激烈争议。

items.titleZh: 维多利亚州工党承诺堵住漏洞，防止家暴施暴者逃脱法律制裁
items.summaryZh: 维多利亚州州长本·卡罗尔承诺，若工党连任，将立法设立新的过失杀人罪，并提高强奸罪的最高刑罚至终身监禁。新法案旨在填补法律漏洞，针对因家暴导致受害者自杀或遗弃受害者的行为进行严惩。
items.whyImportant: 该政策旨在强化对家庭暴力受害者的保护，并填补现有法律在处理极端家暴案件时的空白。
